facts.business: Jaykay Enterprises Limited operates across three core segments: Defence & Aerospace (manufacturing precision parts, composites, underwater mines), Digital Manufacturing & Advanced Systems (additive manufacturing, prototyping, powder metallurgy, reverse engineering), and Digital Services (digital transformation and AI-driven solutions).

guidance_or_targets.statement: Indian Defence & Aerospace sector projected to reach USD 70 billion by 2030
